pages.text: The Jeweler’s Table combines a compatible cut gem with an empty ring or necklace setting. The finished jewelry can then be equipped in its appropriate accessory slot.$(br2)The table will refuse combinations for which no finished jewelry form exists.

Cut gems do not merely hold power. They seem to encourage it to gather. With water, a suitable vessel, and sustained contact, perhaps that power could be drawn out in liquid form.$(br2)I will call the machine I imagine a $(thing)Mana Percolator$(). Its design remains beyond me for the moment, but the principle feels sound.
pages.title: A Method of Percolation
